title: Migrate mention gold to canonical keys and observed-token candidates
description:
Migrate mention gold onto canonical keys while preserving legacy source text for validation and adjudication.

Three surfaces move together:

1. all 29 `annotations/pii_signals.yaml` files rename to `mentions.yaml`;
2. all 357 `pii:` subject keys leave the hard-coded loader exemption and map into canonical concept fields;
3. 339 differing `subject.name` values are preserved as `observedTokenCandidate` with provenance.

The candidate is not automatically authoritative and never participates in matching. Mechanical migration validates it against pinned evidence; suspicious pairs such as `pii:email_address` / `clientID` move to adjudication rather than becoming canonical by copy.

Blocked on the per-layer legacy-name ruling and the temporary compatibility loader. Definition of done: canonical accepted mention rows contain validated concepts and evidence, legacy names remain auditable, and no `pii_signals` or `pii:` exemption reaches scoring.
